summary: Contacts can subscribe to more than one newsletter, and unsubscribe applies to that audience only.
detailed_changes: Non-channel newsletters can be subscribed with double opt-in without a MailingList value.
Unsubscribing one newsletter leaves other confirmed audiences in place.
Account and signed preference pages list extra newsletters alongside the three channel lists.
affected_areas: User groups affected: mailing contacts and account holders
Public impact: people can join more than one audience
Internal impact: channel lists continue to use legacy_list
